entities.name: Nulji of Silla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nulji was the nineteenth ruler (maripgan) of Silla, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea. He was the son of King Naemul and Lady Boban, who was the daughter of King Michu.
